name: [🗣️CALLOUT🗣️] ENTRENCHED 🥀
desc:
🥀 ENTRENCHED is loosely based on early 20th century wars, where the Entente and Central teams face off in the trenches!

💥 Choose from 9 different classes and partake in many battles ranging from turn-based attack and defense frontlines, perpetual attack versus defense conquest, and king of the hill style domination!

🛠️ Version v1.31 [🗣️ Callout Voicelines]
- 🗣️ Callout Voicelines
- 💾 Uniform and hats are saved for each country
- 🪖 Max squad size increased to 6

Playable on PC 🖥️, Mobile 📱 and Console 🎮
